privileged_info_for_vlm: The bank name must be 'Metro City Bank' with Routing No '021000021'. The associated account must be named 'Payroll Checking' with Account No '888999000'. In iDempiere, the 'Checking' account type is represented by the code 'C' or the label 'Checking'. The currency must be 'USD'. All actions must occur within the iDempiere ERP web interface.
